question: When does an aluminum composite (ACM) builder sign beat coroplast on total cost of ownership?
summary: Useful life = min(physical life, message life); ACM wins only when a stable message outlasts coroplast's presentable life (~12-18 mo FL) because each replacement re-pays trip cost. Corpus frames choice by material life only (coroplast 6-18 mo, ACM 3-7 yr) and misses message life, trip cost and ACM+overlay. Corpus corrected me: fading, not flute fatigue, usually ends coroplast.
